b: State endpoint b · shared phase (0–2 cycles; seeking pauses)
bounds: Selected time endpoints: a=0.000 s identifies x(a); b=0.000 s identifies x(b). Work integrates displacement x, not these time limits.
ledger: Chronological contributions: positive +0.000 J; negative 0.000 J; net 0.000 J (their sum).
scope: Boundary 1 · block: spring force is external to the block and is the only force doing nonzero work; weight and support have no horizontal work, so Wnet=Wspring=ΔK. Boundary 2 · block+spring: elastic energy is internal; no driving/friction work enters, so K+U is constant. The net-work theorem still holds when all forces are included. With extra driving or damping, spring work alone need not equal ΔK and K+U need not stay constant; that response experiment has a different ledger.

ledger: 按时间先后分段：正功 +0.000 J；负功 0.000 J；净功 0.000 J（两者相加）。
scope: 边界一·物块：弹簧力是物块的外力，也是唯一做非零功的力；重力与支持力不做水平功，所以 Wnet=Wspring=ΔK。边界二·物块＋弹簧：弹性势能属于内部，无驱动或摩擦功输入，K+U 守恒。净功定理仍须计入全部力；添加驱动或阻尼后，弹簧功单独不一定等于 ΔK，K+U 也不一定守恒，不能照搬到受迫有阻尼实验。
